name: ULTRA-LOW TEMPERATURE -86°C
desc: Premium Vertical Ultra-Low Temperature (ULT) Laboratory Deep Freezer engineered for long-term preservation of critical bio-samples at temperatures down to -86°C. Features a massive 1000-liter SS internal cabinet, heavy-duty cascade refrigeration system, and integrated CO₂ backup system.
features: Operating Temperature Range from -10°C down to -86°C
5 Independent inner storage compartments fitted with insulated sub-doors
Integrated CO₂ Cylinder Backup System for emergency cooling maintenance
Built-in Temperature Chart Recorder for permanent audit monitoring

specifications.Equipment Function: Ultra-Low Temperature long-term storage of critical bio-samples, ATCC cultures, and vaccines
specifications.Cabinet Configuration: Vertical / Upright Type Heavy-Duty Cabinet Layout
specifications.External Enclosure Build: Heavy-Duty Galvanized Steel Body with tough powder-coated exterior finish
specifications.Inner Compartments Design: 5 Independent inner storage compartments fitted with insulated sub-doors
specifications.Shelving & Racking System: 5 Heavy-Duty Corrosion-Resistant Racks included for sample separation
specifications.Mobility & Positioning: Heavy-duty lockable castors with a standard 100 mm ground clearance
specifications.Outer Door Security: Lockable outer doors and lids with ergonomic handle and vacuum release port
specifications.Cooling Mechanism Type: Direct cooling with heavy-duty Cascade Refrigeration System (Dual Compressors)
specifications.Refrigeration Eco-Type: Energy-efficient system using CFC-free & HCFC-free non-flammable green refrigerants
specifications.Pull Down Performance: Rapid thermal response pulling down to maximum low in 2.5 Hours
specifications.Controller Architecture: Microprocessor Digital Electronic Controller Cum Indicator, PID Controller
specifications.Display Interface: High-visibility digital temperature display screen with password security lock
specifications.Integrated Safety Alarms: Audible and visible alarm system for unwanted temp rise, power failure, and system failure
specifications.Emergency Backup Safety: Integrated CO₂ Cylinder Backup System supplied for emergency cooling maintenance
specifications.Data Logging System: Built-in Temperature Chart Recorder provided for permanent audit monitoring
specifications.Voltage Stabilization Support: Supplied with one 5KVA Servo Controller Voltage Stabilizer (5 Years Stabilizer Warranty)
specifications.Acoustic Noise Level: Silent laboratory operations (Maximum Noise Level ≤ 60 dB)
specifications.Energy Consumption Rate: High efficiency eco-design rating at 24 KWh/day
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 5 Years Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty from the date of installation
